_comment: "This may only defend an attack if the attack's controller has destroyed a Agility token this turn." A defend-LEGALITY restriction: DEFEND_RESTRICTION carries conditions and no effects, and actions.get_defendable_cards (the live path _defend_step uses) drops the card when they are unmet. The previous JSON was dead twice over — an ON_DEFEND ability granting a fabricated INTIMIDATE, gated on AGILITY_TOKEN_DESTROYED_THIS_TURN, a flag nothing ever set.
